CONTROLS.NAME: simplify
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn up to simplify the scene into a few splotches of color.

CONTROLS.NAME: sandstorm
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 'Zooms Out' when turned up, causing a grainy effect like a sandstorm.

CONTROLS.NAME: flashing
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Cause the slopes of the texture to highlight on high percussive hits.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulsate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: While ON, pulses emanate outwards synced to the BPM of the song.

CONTROLS.NAME: radial_grid
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A radial grid effect that emanates out from the center like rays of energy.

CONTROLS.NAME: beat_rotate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rotates the main texture on the beat when set to ON. Standard slow rotation when set to OFF.
